notes.title: Cheftastic Pricing Update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]*ANNOUCEMENT Cheftastic FREE* [/b][/h3]

Cheftastic!: Buffet Blast will be going FREE! by approximately the end of November 2024

We want to thank everyone who supported the development of what was originally a student project. 

As the 4 original members move on to new adventures in our lives, we want to make Cheftastic available for all to play so we can share our achievement with all of you


- Please stay tuned for more news on the future of Not A Goose! -

notes.title: Cheftastic 1.0-04 (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
[b]Updated[/b]

[list]
[*]Right stick and D-pad can now be used on controller to scroll through full leaderboard
[*]Enemies now spawn further away from the doors so they are no longer visible when they first spawn in
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*]Hub leaderboard panels not centering around player score
[*]Night mode switch appearing locked when returning to the hub for the first time
[*]Several achievements not activating when complete
[*]Level unlock achievements activating before unlocking their respective levels
[*]Characters getting stuck on top of blenders
[/list]

[b]We are aware of a CTD (Crash To Desktop) affecting some players[/b] and will be investigating this over the next week.


[u][b]How you can help us[/b][/u]

We're doing our best to discover and record any bugs you come across. If you find anything that could be fixed, please don't hesitate to reach out to us to let us know.

Join our discord: [url=https://discord.gg/yVgkHTBy]Cheftastic Community Discord[/url]
